overview_description.description: Tarjama, a certified translation agency in Dubai and across the region, understands that in order to compete in today’s global market, businesses must be able to connect with their customers and stakeholders and communicate about their products and services in a way that fits into the regional and cultural context. What works in Europe or the US may simply not work in the Middle East. As cultural and linguistic experts, we help you transcend geographic borders and communicate globally!

about_short_description.short_description: Tarjama& provides language and translation services for businesses in different markets.

product.name: AMT (Arabic Machine Translation)
product.description: An AI-powered platform for fast, accurate, and scalable Arabic translations tailored for businesses communicating with Arabic-speaking audiences.

product.name: CleverSo
product.description: An Arabic-localized translation management system that integrates with AMT to streamline and automate translation workflows for language professionals.

product.name: T-Portal Enterprise Solutions
product.description: A scalable enterprise platform providing access to Tarjama’s language services and tools for organizations with large content translation needs.

product.name: Translation Services
product.description: Human translation services converting content from source to target languages, ensuring accuracy and cultural appropriateness across various document types.

product.name: Proofreading Services
product.description: Reviewing and correcting final drafts to ensure grammatical accuracy, spelling, punctuation, and syntax without altering content context or terminology.

product.name: Transcription Services
product.description: Converting audio or spoken words into written text in the original language, supporting subsequent translation or captioning.
